thread:
release-bot: Heads up — release week starts now. Release freeze in effect from 22:00 UTC tonight until 06:00 UTC Sunday. Small patch hotfixes allowed with approvals. See checklist: https://redwood/internal/release-checklist
Maya: Quick Q — are canaries still allowed during freeze? Or only hotfix canaries?
Jonah: During freeze, canaries for hotfixes are OK but must run in staging first. No baseline feature-rollout canaries without PM+SRE sign-off.
Eli: FYI there's a known flakiness on embedding ingestion in prod-4, avoid rolling models there until I post a mitigation. Filing a follow-up in #incidents.
Sophia: Please update the release notes with any behavior changes. PM sign-off required for client-facing changes. @Maya @Eli
Maya: ack. I'll flag the embed change in the changelog and include tests to validate.
Jonah: Rollback playbook (if a release causes latency spike):

```
# quick rollback
kubectl -n releases rollout undo deployment/redwood-inference --to-revision=stable
releasectl route-production --to stable
# monitor tokens/sec and 95p latency for 10m
```

Jonah: Also add the `urgent-rollback` label to PRs if you might need to revert.
Sophia: Can we get a short canary dashboard link? Ops, we need 95p latency target < 120ms for this week.
Maya: posted canary dashboard: http://dash/release-week/canary/174
Maya: tagging @Jonah for oncall window tonight 21:30-23:30 UTC :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jonah: I'm oncall. Will run a quick smoke at 21:15 and post results. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to canary-2 completed — 2/2 checks passed
Eli: If something goes sideways, prefer model-variant fallback over full rollback when possible. Fallback steps:

```
releasectl fallback --model redwood-v2-q8b --to redwood-v1
```

Maya: noted. Thanks all. I'll circulate a one-pager and checklist in #eng-releases before EOD. :rocket:
Sophia: thanks — remind devs about feature flags; toggles must be off by freeze unless approved.
Jonah: last note — Dedicated customers: schedule change windows with account team; don't risk SLA breaches.
Maya: closing thread — ping here for any blockers. :pray:
